label: Lenovo Tab P11 (2nd Gen) tablet
description: Lenovo Tab P11 (2nd Gen) — 11.5-inch Android tablet, Wi-Fi 6 (2.4/5 GHz) and LTE on cellular SKUs; USB-C 2.0 port with OTG Ethernet.
notes: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5 GHz) — no 6 GHz. Cellular: LTE Cat 13 on the LTE SKU (no 5G); Wi-Fi-only SKUs have no wwan0. USB-C is USB 2.0, so Ethernet via OTG adapter works but is capped near 100M (declared 1G for topology). Lenovo PSREF is the authoritative source for per-SKU radio loadout.
